title: 2v2 Score-Only-Off-a-Cut Game
description: A constraint game where baskets only count if the shooter received the ball directly off a cut, rewarding movement over standing isolation plays.

content.objective: Reward purposeful cutting by only counting baskets scored directly off a cut.
content.setup: Two offensive players face two defenders in a half-court game with a scoring constraint.
instructions: Play live 2v2 to a target score.
A made basket only counts if the shooter caught the ball directly off a cut, not a standing catch.
Players must constantly move and cut to create legal scoring chances.
Rotate in new pairs after every four possessions.
coachingPoints: Cut with real purpose since standing catches don't score points.
Time cuts to match when the passer is actually able to deliver the ball.
Use screens to help a teammate's cut when it's not your turn to cut.
commonMistakes: Standing still and shooting anyway, forgetting the constraint.
Cutting without any real timing or purpose, just to satisfy the rule.
Playing at a walk-through pace instead of real game speed.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
